name: market-monitoring
description: Monitor custom market symbols, groups, alerts, and quote changes in VS Code.

marketMonitoring.symbols.markdownDescription: Market symbols to monitor. `code` supports A-share forms like `sh600519`, `sz159915`, `600519.SH`, or six-digit codes such as `600519`; US forms like `AAPL`, `US:AAPL`, `NASDAQ:MSFT`, `BRK.B.US`; and Korean forms like `005930.KS`, `035720.KQ`, `ks005930`, `kq035720`.

cost.description: Optional cost basis used to calculate net profit.

holding.description: Optional holding quantity used to calculate net profit.

marketMonitoring.groups.markdownDescription: Custom groups shown in the market monitoring view. Empty groups are kept visible so symbols can be added inside a specific group.

marketMonitoring.onlyDuringTradingTime.description: Refresh only during configured active market sessions. Market holidays are not automatically detected.

marketMonitoring.showStatusBar.description: Show a compact market summary in the VS Code status bar.

marketMonitoring.showMarketBreadth.description: Show full-market rising, falling, and flat stock counts in the quote view footer.

marketMonitoring.marketBreadthRefreshInt.description: Full-market rising, falling, and flat stock count refresh interval in seconds.

threshold.description: Price threshold used to choose decimal places.

belowThreshold.description: Decimal places used when the absolute value is below the threshold.

fromThreshold.description: Decimal places used when the absolute value is greater than or equal to the threshold.

marketMonitoring.priceDecimalPlaces.markdownDescription: Decimal places used for quote price display. Use a number for the legacy fixed behavior, or an object such as `{ "threshold": 10, "belowThreshold": 3, "fromThreshold": 2 }`.

marketMonitoring.compactLargeAmounts.description: Display values greater than 10000 using W units in group summaries and exported summary rows.

marketMonitoring.enableGroupSummaryDrawd.description: Show a drawdown marker next to group total assets when the value falls from its current high by more than the configured threshold.

marketMonitoring.groupSummaryDrawdownThr.description: Drawdown percentage threshold for group total assets. The marker appears when total assets fall from the current high by more than this percentage.

enumDescriptions: Follow the current VS Code display language.
marketMonitoring.language.description: Display language for the Market Monitoring view.

enumDescriptions: Do not color price change indicators.
Use red for rising values and green for falling values.
Use green for rising values and red for falling values.
marketMonitoring.colorMode.description: Color mode for rising and falling indicators.

marketMonitoring.rowHighlightUpPercent.description: Show a subtle left row marker when quote change percentage is greater than or equal to this value. Set 0 to disable rising row markers.

marketMonitoring.rowHighlightDownPercent.description: Show a subtle left row marker when quote change percentage is less than or equal to the negative of this value. Set 0 to disable falling row markers.

marketMonitoring.quoteColumns.markdownDescription: Columns displayed in the quote table. The array order controls the left-to-right column order. For button-style move up/down controls, run `Market Monitoring: Configure Quote Columns`.

enumDescriptions: Calculated market value from latest price multiplied by holding quantity.
Calculated position percentage within the group.

marketMonitoring.groupSummaryMetrics.markdownDescription: Metrics displayed in each group summary row. Empty hides the summary row.

enumDescriptions: Total assets from latest price multiplied by holding quantity.
Today profit from price change multiplied by holding quantity.
Today profit percentage based on previous close assets.
Sort held symbols by market value and keep symbols without calculable market value in configured order.

marketMonitoring.sortDirection.description: Sort direction for sortable quote fields.

marketMonitoring.enableAlertNotification.description: Show VS Code notifications when quote alerts are newly triggered.

marketMonitoring.ai.enabled.description: Show and enable the AI assistant entry for natural-language group and symbol management.

marketMonitoring.ai.provider.markdownDescription: AI provider used by the natural-language group and symbol manager.

marketMonitoring.ai.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the selected AI provider. Leave empty for local providers such as Ollama or LM Studio.

marketMonitoring.ai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Optional API base URL. For OpenAI-compatible providers this should be the API root, for example `https://api.openai.com/v1` or `http://localhost:11434/v1`.

marketMonitoring.ai.azureApiVersion.markdownDescription: Azure OpenAI API version. `marketMonitoring.ai.model` is treated as the Azure deployment name.

marketMonitoring.alerts.markdownDescription: Alert rules. A rule can contain one or more thresholds such as `priceAbove`, `priceBelow`, `changePercentAbove`, or `changePercentBelow`.

name.description: Optional display name used in alert notifications.

priceAbove.description: Trigger when latest price is greater than or equal to this value.

priceBelow.description: Trigger when latest price is less than or equal to this value.

changePercentAbove.description: Trigger when change percentage is greater than or equal to this value.

changePercentBelow.description: Trigger when change percentage is less than or equal to this value.

movingAverageBelow.description: Trigger an intraday break-below alert when the previous close was greater than or equal to the previous N-day moving average and the latest price is less than the current N-day moving average. Enabled by default for each alert rule; set false to disable.

movingAverageDays.description: Moving average window or windows used by movingAverageBelow, movingAverageHoldBelow, movingAverageAbove, and movingAverageHoldAbove when their specific day fields are not set. Defaults to 5, 10, 20, 60, and 120.

movingAverageBelowDays.description: Compatibility shorthand: setting this also enables movingAverageBelow.

movingAverageS.description: Trigger an S alert when the latest price is at or below the configured N-day moving average after applying the downside offset. Enabled by default for each alert rule; set false to disable.

movingAverageSDays.description: Moving average window or windows used by movingAverageS. Defaults to 20. Setting this also enables movingAverageS.

movingAverageSOffsetPercent.description: Downside offset percentage used by movingAverageS. For example, 4 triggers when price is less than or equal to MA(N) * 0.96.

movingAverageHoldBelow.description: Trigger a close-confirmed lost-support alert after market close when the previous close was greater than or equal to the previous N-day moving average and the latest closing price is less than the current N-day moving average. Disabled by default; set true to enable.

movingAverageHoldBelowDays.description: Moving average window or windows used by movingAverageHoldBelow. Setting this also enables movingAverageHoldBelow.

movingAverageAbove.description: Trigger an intraday stand-above alert when the previous close was below the previous N-day moving average and the latest price is greater than or equal to the current N-day moving average. Disabled by default; set true to enable.

movingAverageAboveDays.description: Moving average window or windows used by movingAverageAbove. Setting this also enables movingAverageAbove.

movingAverageHoldAbove.description: Trigger a close-confirmed stand-stable alert after market close when the previous close was below the previous N-day moving average and the latest closing price is greater than or equal to the current N-day moving average. Disabled by default; set true to enable.

movingAverageHoldAboveDays.description: Moving average window or windows used by movingAverageHoldAbove. Setting this also enables movingAverageHoldAbove.

bearishMovingAverage.description: Trigger when moving averages are in bearish order: short < mid < long.

bearishMovingAverageShortDays.description: Short moving average window for bearishMovingAverage.

bearishMovingAverageMidDays.description: Middle moving average window for bearishMovingAverage.

bearishMovingAverageLongDays.description: Long moving average window for bearishMovingAverage.

macdDeathCross.description: Trigger when MACD DIF crosses below DEA.

macdBelowZeroOnly.description: Only trigger MACD death-cross alerts when both DIF and DEA are below zero.

volumeDrop.description: Trigger on price drop with current daily volume above the configured average-volume multiplier.

volumeDropPercent.description: Minimum negative change percentage for volumeDrop.

volumeDropMultiplier.description: Current volume must be at least this many times the average volume for volumeDrop.

reboundLowVolume.description: Trigger when price rebounds while current daily volume is below the configured average-volume ratio.

reboundRisePercent.description: Minimum positive change percentage for reboundLowVolume.

reboundLowVolumeRatio.description: Current volume must be less than or equal to this ratio of average volume for reboundLowVolume.

lowBreak.description: Trigger when latest price breaks below the lowest low of the configured recent window.

lowBreakDays.description: Lookback window for lowBreak. Setting this also enables lowBreak.

rsiWeak.description: Trigger when RSI is below the configured threshold.

bollingerBelow.description: Trigger when latest price is below Bollinger middle or lower band. true means middle.

intradayHighPullback.description: Trigger when the symbol's high rises above today's open, change percentage turns negative, and price has fallen from today's high by more than the configured percentage. After close, the daily K-line close is used.

intradayHighPullbackPercent.description: Minimum pullback percentage from today's high for intradayHighPullback.

intradayDowntrendConfirmTicks.description: Number of consecutive refreshes required to confirm an intraday downtrend.

intradayDowntrendSlopePoints.description: Number of recent refresh prices used to confirm a negative intraday slope.

intradayVwapBelow.description: Require price to be below intraday VWAP when VWAP is available.
